g.text: 1. Function: power instrumentation (T1-026, must): five INA236 on I2C1 at 1.8 V (VIH 0.9 V at any

g.desc: 1. Function: power instrumentation (T1-026, must): five INA236 on I2C1 at 1.8 V (VIH 0.9 V at any

g.text: VS, SBOSA81D §6.5), VS on vcc3v3_sys; positions and shunts per power tree §4.12 (G11).

g.desc: VS, SBOSA81D §6.5), VS on vcc3v3_sys; positions and shunts per power tree §4.12 (G11).

g.text: 2. Absent state: an INA236 unfitted leaves its shunt in circuit and its address free (power tree

g.desc: 2. Absent state: an INA236 unfitted leaves its shunt in circuit and its address free (power tree

g.text: §5). The parts power up converting (MODE 111b, 0.3 mA each): Blackbird OS writes power-down.

g.desc: §5). The parts power up converting (MODE 111b, 0.3 mA each): Blackbird OS writes power-down.

g.text: 3. Shunts (Vishay WSL, doc 30100): 10 mΩ 2512 1 W (VSYS: 58 mW at 2.4 A, 0.36 W at the 6 A

g.desc: 3. Shunts (Vishay WSL, doc 30100): 10 mΩ 2512 1 W (VSYS: 58 mW at 2.4 A, 0.36 W at the 6 A

g.text: BATFET rating); 20 mΩ 2010 0.5 W (HAT, line 54 asks for 0.5 W or more); 20 mΩ 1206 (audio);

g.desc: BATFET rating); 20 mΩ 2010 0.5 W (HAT, line 54 asks for 0.5 W or more); 20 mΩ 1206 (audio);

g.text: 100 mΩ 1206 (display: 11 mW at 0.33 A). Full scale 81.92 mV / R: 8.2, 4.1, 0.82 A.

g.desc: 100 mΩ 1206 (display: 11 mW at 0.33 A). Full scale 81.92 mV / R: 8.2, 4.1, 0.82 A.

g.text: 4. A0 (SBOSA81D Table 7-1): GND, VS, SCL for 0x40, 0x41, 0x43; INA236B GND, VS for 0x48, 0x49.

g.desc: 4. A0 (SBOSA81D Table 7-1): GND, VS, SCL for 0x40, 0x41, 0x43; INA236B GND, VS for 0x48, 0x49.

g.text: No A0 = SDA: it needs 100 ns more hold (p. 16), and U-Boot leaves the RK3566 hold at 1 clock.

g.desc: No A0 = SDA: it needs 100 ns more hold (p. 16), and U-Boot leaves the RK3566 hold at 1 clock.

g.text: 5. ALERT open (may float, SBOSA81D Table 5-1). Kelvin traces from IN+ and IN- to the shunt pads

g.desc: 5. ALERT open (may float, SBOSA81D Table 5-1). Kelvin traces from IN+ and IN- to the shunt pads

g.text: (SBOSA81D §8.4.1); never issue a general-call reset on I2C1 (it resets all five, p. 18).

g.desc: (SBOSA81D §8.4.1); never issue a general-call reset on I2C1 (it resets all five, p. 18).
